Q2 was a strong quarter for Kingstone with 10.06% return.

Highest returns this quarter were driven by TMT stock picks including Western Digital, Micron, Sensata and Sterling Infrastructure. Our portfolio managers capitalised on the ‘AI Trade’ for multiple different layers of the AI ecosystem.
Western Digital, a storage manufacturer was identified to be trading at a discount compared to competitors with strong fundamentals and a key choke point for the buildout of AI data centres. Micron, a memory provider had massive backlog was again bought at an attractive valuation in Q1’26.

Our analysis suggested that they had high growth potential for gross profit margins when looking at the large supply and demand imbalance going into the future. Sensata is a sustainable technology company that has a range of products used for the build out of technology infrastructure. A new leadership team has taken the firm in a new direction, targeting strong free cashflow growth and has consistently beat earnings expectations. Furthermore, the start of the year saw economic tailwinds that promoted the growth of small cap companies like Sensata. Finally, Sterling Infrastructure is an infrastructure construction company that shifted its specialisation toward the construction of data centres, this saw a large boost in earnings, resulting in a 57% upside surprise in Q1’26 earnings.

Other areas the firm has invested in are Industrials, with positions in clean energy and rare earth mining. We also hold stakes in financials, aiming to capitalize on high M&A and IPO activity this year. Finally, we also own EM value and EM small cap ETF’s as a bet on the ‘catch-up’ of EM economies following years of slow growth.
Reflecting on this quarter, our next goal is to continue to build out our risk controls. We’re looking to implement more beta neutral strategies such as relative value trades to reduce portfolio volatility and generate returns that are uncorrelated to market movements. Our team is excited to work on this and see how we can further improve our risk management and alpha generation strategies.

Ethan Ghosh, CIO
